0022600186.text: The LA Clippers (1-5, 1-1 at home, 13th in the West) host the Miami Heat (2-4, winners of their last two, 10th in the East), with the Clippers on a five-game losing streak. The Clippers are missing Bradley Beal (knee), Brandon Ingram (Achilles), Derrick Jones Jr. (knee), Jordan Miller (shoulder), Rui Hachimura (quadriceps), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot). The teams have not met yet this season, and the Clippers lost both matchups in 2025-26, most recently 140-123 in Miami on December 1, 2025.
